_rule: Structure ratchet for web/js and web/custom.js, checked by hub/web-structure-web.test.ts and frozen by .githooks/pre-push. A fix lowers the number in the same commit; never raise one.

reasons.currentAssign 05-command-palette.js: go() is the one navigation entry and the only place current changes.
reasons.rawNet 01-forbidden-pair.js: window.fetch wrapper: every response, api() or raw, passes the pairing gate (403 with X-Dotz-Pair) first.
reasons.rawNet 11-mailbody.js: the mail's stored HTML body (text, not JSON, which api() would turn into null) and inline image blobs read through a cache-friendly fetch, not JSON calls.
reasons.rawNet 15-attachments.js: file bodies and HEAD probes of attachments, not JSON calls.
reasons.rawNet 15-upload.js: XMLHttpRequest for upload progress, which fetch cannot report.
reasons.rawNet 17-state-refresh.js: keepalive input-diagnostics beacon; beacons must not mark the page alive, so they stay outside api().
reasons.rawNet 23-installable-app-web.js: keepalive push tap and presence beacons; beacons must not mark the page alive, so they stay outside api().
reasons.rawNet 30-canvas.js: canvas file body, not a JSON call.
reasons.rawNet 31-conversations.js: keepalive viewing beacon on unload; beacons must not mark the page alive, so they stay outside api().
reasons.rawNet 34-input-diag.js: input-diagnostics report that may go out as a keepalive beacon on page hide.
reasons.rawNet 36-shell.js: streamed terminal output read chunk by chunk with an abort signal.
reasons.rawNet 99-boot.js: the live event stream (EventSource), not a JSON call.
